description: Comprehensive manifest of every external dependency source consumed by the AyuGramDesktop build system. Inventoried from Telegram/build/prepare/prepare.py (Windows/macOS native builds), Telegram/build/docker/centos_env/Dockerfile (Linux container build), Telegram/build/qt_version.py (Qt version selector), and the repository git submodules (.gitmodules).

pin_type_legend.sha-immutable: Pinned to an immutable git commit SHA fetched directly (Dockerfile `git fetch --depth=1 origin <sha>`) or checked out after a branchless clone (prepare.py `git clone ... && git checkout <sha>`), OR an archive download verified by a sha256 checksum / a container image pinned by digest. The pinned artifact cannot move.
pin_type_legend.tag+checkout-pinned: Cloned via a git tag/branch ref (`git clone -b <tag>`) and then reset to a specific commit SHA (`git checkout <sha>`). The tag is only a fetch convenience; the SHA is the real pin.
pin_type_legend.branch: Cloned via a branch or checked out to a moving tag with no commit SHA pinning. The resolved commit can change if the upstream ref moves (weak pin).
pin_type_legend.runtime-variable: Version or ref is resolved at runtime from an environment variable, or the artifact is downloaded without integrity verification (e.g. a 'latest' URL or a fixed URL with no checksum). Not reproducibly pinned.

unresolved_to_sha: gas-preprocessor (git clone, no checkout/pin - default branch HEAD)
libvpx [prepare.py] (checked out tag v1.14.1, no commit SHA pinned)
protobuf [prepare.py] (cloned -b v21.9 branch tip, no commit SHA pinned)
qt5/qt6 [prepare.py] (branch v$QT[-lts-lgpl] from runtime $QT env, no commit SHA pinned)
dnf system packages [Dockerfile] (rpm packages, latest from repos)
summary.note: total_deps counts downloadable/cloneable dependency entries across prepare_py, dockerfile and submodules. qt_version.py provides Qt version-selection metadata (3 selectors) and is documented separately below; it is not counted in total_deps to avoid double-counting the Qt clone.

prepare_py.name: patches
prepare_py.notes: Branchless git clone followed by git checkout of a pinned SHA. Source of build patches applied to many later stages.

prepare_py.name: msys64
prepare_py.notes: Downloaded self-extracting MSYS2 base archive. URL is pinned to a dated release but NO checksum/integrity verification is performed. win only. pacman then installs make, mingw-w64 diffutils/gperf/nasm/perl/pkgconf.

prepare_py.name: python (build venv)
prepare_py.notes: Creates a venv from host Python and `pip install pywin32 six meson` with no version pins. Used to provide meson on Windows.

prepare_py.name: NuGet
prepare_py.notes: Downloads the 'latest' nuget.exe with no checksum verification. win only.

prepare_py.name: jom
prepare_py.notes: Fixed-version URL but no checksum verification. win only.

prepare_py.name: gyp (mac)

prepare_py.notes: Branchless clone then `git checkout v1.14.1` (a tag, not a commit SHA). Patches from patches/libvpx applied. WEAK PIN: the tag could be moved upstream. NOTE: the Dockerfile instead pins libvpx to a specific commit SHA (12f3a2ac...).

prepare_py.name: googletest

prepare_py.name: tg_angle
prepare_py.notes: Branchless clone + checkout SHORT SHA e3f59e8d0c. Only built when Qt < 6 (Qt 5). win only. Dockerfile does not use tg_angle (Qt 6 only).

prepare_py.name: qt5/qt6
prepare_py.notes: `git clone -b <branch>` where the branch name is derived at runtime from the $QT env var (set by qt_version.py: 5.15.19 on win non-arm Qt5, else 6.11.1). `git submodule update --init --recursive` of qtbase/qtimageformats/qtsvg (+ qtdeclarative/qtwayland/qtshadertools for Qt6) with NO explicit commit SHA pin — relies on the branch/tag tip. patches/qtbase_$QT applied. WEAK PIN. NOTE: the Dockerfile instead pins Qt to a specific commit SHA (bfde7b89...).

prepare_py.name: tg_owt (WebRTC)
prepare_py.notes: Branchless clone + checkout SHA, then `git submodule update --init --recursive` (submodules pinned by tg_owt tree). Same SHA used by the Dockerfile.

prepare_py.name: ada
prepare_py.notes: `git clone -b v3.2.4` then checkout pinned SHA. Same SHA used by the Dockerfile.

prepare_py.name: protobuf
prepare_py.notes: `git clone --recursive -b v21.9` with NO explicit commit SHA for protobuf itself — resolves to the v21.9 branch/tag tip. Nested submodules are pinned by the protobuf tree. WEAK PIN. mac variant is commented out. NOTE: the Dockerfile instead pins protobuf to a specific commit SHA (43e16268...).

prepare_py.name: abseil-cpp (in protobuf)
prepare_py.notes: Branchless clone into protobuf/third_party/abseil-cpp + checkout SHORT SHA 273292d1cf. win only (mac protobuf is commented out).

prepare_py.name: tde2e
prepare_py.notes: Branchless clone (into tde2e/) + checkout SHORT SHA 51743df. Same commit (full SHA) used by the Dockerfile.

qt_version_py.description: Telegram/build/qt_version.py selects the Qt version by setting the QT environment variable, which drives the qt5/qt6 clone branch in prepare.py and the QT/QT_SHA env in the Dockerfile. These are version selectors, not separate dependencies, and are excluded from total_deps to avoid double-counting the Qt clone.

selectors.feeds: prepare.py qt5/qt6 stage -> branch v6.11.1 (no SHA); Dockerfile QT=6.11.1 QT_SHA=bfde7b89...

selectors.condition: win32 with arch=='arm' OR 'qt6' in sys.argv
selectors.feeds: prepare.py qt5/qt6 stage -> branch v6.11.1 (no SHA)
prepare.py qt5 stage -> branch v5.15.19-lts-lgpl (no SHA); also enables the tg_angle stage

cross_source_drift.description: Dependencies where the Windows/macOS (prepare.py) and Linux (Dockerfile) builds pin DIFFERENT commits of the same upstream. These are reproducibility and supply-chain consistency risks worth tracking.
